verdict.rationale: Capsule CRM documents automation-like features such as Tracks (sequenced tasks) and repeating tasks, but nothing shows versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. Restoring deleted records within 30 days is an adjacent record-recovery feature, not automation version control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
